```{r}
#Importing datasets and joining them: @nykmate
english <- read_csv("data/raw/caffeine_sensitivity_english_clean.csv") %>%
  filter(caff_intox_revised_13 == 4) %>%
  mutate(sample = "English") %>%
  select(sample, age, gender, caff_sens, caffeine_perday, caff_intox_revised_1:caff_intox_revised_12)

hungarian <- read_csv("data/raw/caffeine_sensitivity_clean copy.csv") %>%
  filter(if_all(
      all_of(paste0("caff_intox_revised_", 1:12)),
      ~ !is.na(.x))) %>%
  mutate(caff_sens = factor(caff_sens, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))) %>%
  mutate(sample = "Hungarian") %>%
  select(sample, age, gender, caff_sens, caffeine_perday, caff_intox_revised_1:caff_intox_revised_12)

caff_sens_invariance <- bind_rows(english, hungarian)
```
